The branch already existed from the interrupted run. It was still at 9403838 with no commits of its own, so I switched to it instead of creating it again.

COMMITS
- a9c04af "Name the mistakes behind a wrong grid-in on every ratios and rates template" (on top of base 9403838)

CHANGE
- /Users/workingmyassof/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_c70c4702-929-16/satbank/topics/ratios_rates_proportions_and_units/values.py: this file plays the role of `kit.py` for this topic. It holds the `spr()` helper, and every grid-in in the topic is built there, so this is the one place `spr_mistakes` can be passed to `Item(...)` by keyword.
  - `spr()` has two new keyword arguments, `mistakes=()` and `round_to=None`. It sets `spr_mistakes=gridin_mistakes(k, _wrong(mistakes, round_to))`, where `k` is the same `Num` that is the item's `key`.
  - `_wrong()` is the MCQ filter from `_options()`, moved out unchanged so both paths use it: it skips None, rounds to `round_to`, and drops values of zero or less. `_options()` now calls it.
- /Users/workingmyassof/satbank/.claude/worktrees/wf_c70c4702-929-16/satbank/topics/ratios_rates_proportions_and_units/families/{ratios,rates,units}.py: each of the 14 `spr(...)` calls now passes `mistakes=mistakes`.
  - `rate_convert` also passes `round_to=Q(1, 10**places)` when `places` is set, because the trip stem asks for the nearest tenth.
  - `cube_density` passes its existing `round_to`, because the edge and mass stems ask for rounded answers.
  - Nowhere else is the grid-in key rounded, so the other templates pass exact mistake values.
- No mistakes list had to move. In all 14 templates it was already built before the SPR branch, and building it uses no rng and cannot raise. The rng draw order is therefore untouched.

rr.partner, rr.equivalent, rr.table_constant, rr.chain_unknown, rr.repeated_factor, rr.unit_rate, rr.rate_convert, rr.rate_product, rr.gap, rr.exchange_fee, rr.convert, rr.convert_chain, rr.pop_density, rr.cube_density

- One edge case: in rr.cube_density, when the edge is 1, every mistake value equals the key. `gridin_mistakes` then drops them all and the item ships with an empty list, which is correct. In seeds 0-60 this happened in 6 of 85 grid-ins (seeds 30, 34, 37, 38, 41).
